title: kv case bodies
description: How the toy `kv` tree declares its own case-body shape. The kit never reads this file's contents -- a validator applies it alongside case-tree/expect.schema.json, which knows only that `kind` exists. Note that `merge.then` here is accept|refuse; rowspec's `merge.then` is evaluate|refuse. Same kind name, different vocabulary, and neither tree is wrong: kind names are tree-local.

allOf.$comment: A kind nobody declared must be rejected here, not skipped. A tree that quietly accepts an unknown kind is a tree whose declaration stopped covering it.
